messages:
laura_finance: FYI getting a customer dispute on today's Azure Marketplace invoice — seats show as 120 on the invoice but partner portal shows staggered activations, should've billed ~98 pro-rated seats. Can someone help trace the meterlines?

matt_partner_success: ugh, that will cause a big refund if we can't justify it. do we have the subscription id and activation schedule?

laura_finance: subscription: sub-0a1b2c3d, partner reported activations 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-10 in batches. invoice generated 2026-03-01 00:00 UTC so looks like portal and invoice timing misaligned.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03-14-sub-0a1b2c3d created for amount $4,320.00 (120 seats at rate $36). Billing period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31.

sophia_ops: can someone paste the raw meterline export? need to see timestamps + quantity deltas.

laura_finance: pasted below (redacted):
```
2026-03-01T00:00:00Z,sub-0a1b2c3d,plan:pro,seats:50
2026-03-03T14:12:07Z,sub-0a1b2c3d,plan:pro,seats:+30
2026-03-07T09:05:02Z,sub-0a1b2c3d,plan:pro,seats:+20
2026-03-10T18:47:11Z,sub-0a1b2c3d,plan:pro,seats:+20
```

laura_finance: total shows 120 by 3/10 but invoice snapshot ran at 3/1. looks like partner portal later recorded earlier activations?

raj_billing: if invoice snapshot is 3/1 we should have billed 50, not 120. how did invoice-bot get 120? possible duplicate webhook or delayed ingestion from partner connector.

matt_partner_success: tagging @partner-ops to confirm their ingestion timings, but we should prepare a provisional credit plan in case it's on us. propose refund credit for prorated period for seats activated after invoice snapshot (3/1).

sophia_ops: agree. action items: 1) AP to hold payment until reconciled (laura) 2) open ticket with marketplace partner to confirm raw events and webhook delivery (matt) 3) run ingestion debug for connector for 2/28-3/05 window (sophia)

laura_finance: noted. I'll set payment hold and draft a provisional credit memo for the amount difference: (120 billed - 50 snapshot) * $36 = $2,520, then prorate for activations after 3/1 (approx $720) — will confirm exact calc once partner provides raw events.

billing-bot: Created ticket TCK-4857: "Azure marketplace meter ingestion discrepancy - sub-0a1b2c3d". Assigned to eng-ops.

matt_partner_success: thanks. partner-ops replied in DMs, they saw delayed SQS processing around 2026-03-02 01:00 UTC. could be the gap. I'll escalate.

raj_billing: provisional credit approved by finance lead for up to $3k pending final reconciliation. Laura please attach final credit memo to TCK-4857 when ready.

laura_finance: will do. estimate we resolve by EOD Thu. leaving note for anyone else who bumps into similar: double-check invoice snapshot timezone vs partner event times — we've seen portal timezone drift before. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt_partner_success: good call. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
